title: JUMBLE'S BUNGALOW
description: This creative-based mod adds bright neon cosmetic blocks, bioluminescent plants, and weird alien music discs to the game. You can also open a portal to an empty, dark cave dimension and build a new world from the ground up!
body:
Note: this mod ties in to the ongoing horror story and worldbuilding featured on my youtube channel, and is intended for an older audience. Some aspects may not be appropriate for young children.

Update: HOLOGRAPHICA IS NOW WORKING. The bug that was causing it to break in a multiplayer setting has now been patched.

A creative-only mod with a very simple premise- open a portal into a dark, empty, brand new dimension and start creating your own world from the ground up.

Adds:

Several different blank dimensions to build a new world in:

- empty, dark, Nether-like custom dimension with grass and flooded caverns
- bright Valley E'Haven overworld dimension with tons of flowers
- cozy, foggy Still Pond swamp world
- eerie, mysterious dimension called Oob
- bright, relentlessly pink, super cutesy world called Holographica

Also adds:

- neon building materials (bricks, tiles, etc) and custom cosmetic blocks
- glowing flowers and logs
- music discs with custom tracks
- alphabet blocks that allow for writing messages in large lettering
- server-side transparent windows that allow players to see through opaque blocks*


Instructions to get started:

Requires Neoforge and Minecraft version 1.21.4 to run.

In creative mode, open the Bungalow Plants tab to find the Blue Jewel Log blocks, and then build a portal frame like you would to go to the Nether.
Then go to the vanilla tools and utilities tab and scroll all the way down, where the PKosmyr Portal Igniter is located.
Right-click the portal frame to ignite, and step through.

This will give you access to the PKosmyr Hell dimension, which is planned to be the first of many empty planes- eventually every Jewel Log color may open a door to other worlds.

The Valley E'Haven portal is the same as the above, but with Cyan Jewel Logs in place of the blue ones.

Still Pond, Oob, and Holographica are the same, but with green, magenta, and Spectral logs specifically.



*(these are _completely disabled_ and unplaceable in _all_ vanilla dimensions to prevent xray cheating, and are intended _only_ for use within the added custom dimension(s) for creative purposes)
